author_reading_scope: Read the complete relevant theorem and algorithm sections in the full official Achiam et al. PMLR paper and the complete proof argument in its full official supplement. The supplement's finite-state discounted occupancy identity, arbitrary-baseline return identity, total-variation resolvent estimate, and Theorem 1 proof were read through the final inequality. Also read the relevant formulation and discounted-occupation sections in Altman's complete 250-page author-hosted book. The book uses a normalized discounted cost (factor 1-gamma); local items explicitly retain Achiam's unnormalized expected discounted sum. The finite-action KL lemma reuses the current published Pinsker theorem only under AC, and locally proves the finite event-supremum/half-l1 identification and weighted square-root/Jensen bound.
